result.brief: 提出以显式4D场景（规范网格+逐帧刚体变换）为条件的视频世界模型，通过深度视频与Motion Adapter实现相机与物体精确控制，并给出新数据集与IG-IoU评测。
result.reason: Explicit 4D scene representation (canonical meshes + rigid transforms) conditions a video world model for camera/object control, directly matching video world model and controllable video generation.
